articles.title: Analyst Report: Citigroup Inc.
articles.summary: Morningstar Research: Analyst Report: Citigroup Inc.. Citigroup is a global financial-services company doing business in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions. Citigroup's operations are organized into five primary segments: services, markets, banking, US personal banking, and wealth management. The bank's primary services include cross-border banking needs for multinational corporates, investment banking and trading, and credit card services in the United States.
